answer: The strongest single control I know for this is liquidity-locked bond redeemable only after season end, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 704 keys multiplies the price 704-fold: 83776 POA locked, or 11968 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the lagoon up to the light, weigh the plume of the attack, and keep the yarrow of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
